δόρυ: δόρυ — wood, tree-trunk; spear (a shaft of wood); neut. nom./acc. sg. (gen. δουρός)

κλέος: κλέος — fame, renown; neut. nom. sg., subject: ’fame’ · also neut. acc. sg., object: ’a report’ · also neut. acc. sg., object: ’fame, a good name’ (κλέος … ἄροιτο ’win fame’)
κρατερὸς: κρατερός — mighty, strong; adj., masc. nom. sg.

κῦδος: κῦδος — glory, the lustre of success granted by a god; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., in apposition: ’glory’

λίθος: λίθος — stone, rock; masc. nom. sg., predicate noun
λυκάονος: Λυκάων — Lycaon, father of Pandarus; masc. gen. sg. · also Lycaon, a son of Priam and brother of Paris; masc. gen. sg.

μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.

μεγάροισι: μέγαρον — hall; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)

οὕνεκ: οὕνεκα — because, for that reason; conj., elided (οὕνεκ’ = οὕνεκα)
οὕτω: οὕτω(ς) — thus, so, in this way; adv.
οὕτως: οὕτω(ς) — so, thus, in this way; adv.
πάνδαρος: Πάνδαρος — Pandarus, son of Lycaon, a Trojan leader; masc. nom. sg.
πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv.: ’once before’, with a finite verb · also with a participle: ’already, from before’ (πάρος μεμαυῖαν ’already eager’)
παλλὰς: Παλλάς — Pallas, a title of Athena; fem. nom. sg.

τέκε: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= ἔτεκε)

ταχυπώλων: ταχύπωλος — with swift colts, with swift horses (ταχύς + πῶλος); masc. gen. pl.

τεὸν: τεός (epic possessive = σός) — your, yours; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with γέρας · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with μένος

τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’

τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.

τόξων: τόξον — bow; neut. gen. pl. (τόξα), gen. of respect after εἰδώς: ’skilled in bows’
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’

τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’

φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. voc. sg., agreeing with τέκος: ’dear (child)’
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φόβον: φόβος — fear, flight, panic; masc. acc. sg.
χαλκείη: χάλκειος — of bronze, bronze; fem. nom. sg., Ionic -είη (= Attic χαλκῆ)
χαλκὸν: χαλκός — bronze; masc. acc. sg.: ’the bronze’ (i.e. armour) · also the bronze weapon, the spear-point: ’the bronze’ (χαλκὸν ἀνασχέσθαι ’to withstand the bronze’)
χαλκὸς: χαλκός — bronze, copper; also a bronze blade; masc. nom. sg.
ἀγλαὸς: ἀγλαός — splendid, radiant; masc. nom. sg.
ἀγχίσαο: Ἀγχίσης — Anchises; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
ἀγόρευε: ἀγορεύω — speak, declare; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἠγόρευε)
ἀγόρευον: ἀγορεύω — speak, address an assembly; impf. 3 pl.
ἀγὸς: ἀγός — leader, commander; masc. nom. sg.
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀλλήλους: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., masc. acc. pl.: ’one another’
ἀμπεπαλὼν: ἀναπάλλω — swing up, brandish; aor. 2 part. act., masc. nom. sg., reduplicated, ἀμ- by assimilation of ἀνά
ἀμφοτέρω: ἀμφότερος — both; masc. acc. dual, agreeing with a dual noun: ’both’
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)
ἀμύμονος: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (an old epithet whose exact force is uncertain); masc. gen. sg.
ἀνσχήσεσθαι: ἀνέχομαι — hold out, endure; fut. inf. mid. (ἀνσχ- for ἀνασχ-; Attic ἀνέξεσθαι): ’to endure’
ἀντίον: ἀντίον — opposite, face to face; adv. or prep. + gen.: ’in opposition to, to the face of’
ἀντίος: ἀντίος — opposite, facing, to meet (+ gen.); masc. nom. sg.
ἀντιβίην: ἀντίβιος — opposing, hostile; fem. acc. sg. used as an adv.: ’in open opposition, against’
ἀπόρουσε: ἀπορούω — spring away, leap off; aor. 3 sg.: ’sprang away’
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
ἀράβησε: ἀραβέω — clatter, rattle; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἠράβησε)
ἀσπίδι: ἀσπίς — shield; fem. dat. sg., of means: ’by his shield’
ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
ἀφ: ἀπό — from, away from; prep. + gen., elided and aspirated before a rough breathing (ἀφ’ = ἀπό)
ἀφροδίτη: Ἀφροδίτη — Aphrodite, goddess of love; fem. nom. sg.
ἀχαιοί: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιούς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’) · also modal particle with the subj. after ὅτ’: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂν … γένωνται ’whenever they come to be’) · also modal particle with a fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’could’ (οὐκ ἂν … μυθήσομαι ’I could not tell’) · also εἴ περ ἂν + opt., ’even if … should’ · also εἴ περ ἂν + subj., ’even if … ever’ (εἴ περ ἂν αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’even if they set upon him’) · also εἰ … ἂν + subj., ’if ever, should’ (εἰ δ’ ἂν … ἐθέλωσιν ’but if they should be unwilling’) · also with an indic. past tense, contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἂν … ἦεν ’would have been’)
ἄγ: ἄγε (elided ἄγ’) — come!, come now; interjection, originally 2 sg. imper. of ἄγω ’lead’, used before another imperative
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
ἄλλο: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. acc. sg.: ’another thing’
ἄμφω: ἄμφω — both; dual adj./pron., of two persons: ’both (of them)’
ἄναξ: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form), in address: ’lord!’ (κλῦθι, ἄναξ ’hear me, lord’)
ἄνδρ: ἀνήρ — man; masc. acc. sg., elided (ἄνδρ’ = ἄνδρα)
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄρηα: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic Ἄρη) · also by metonymy ’war’ (πολύδακρυν Ἄρηα ’tearful war’)
ἄριστοι: ἄριστος — best; superl. of ἀγαθός, masc. nom. pl.
ἄϋσε: ἀΰω — shout, call aloud; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἤϋσε): ’shouted’
ἐγένοντο: γίγνομαι — become, be born; aor. 3 pl. mid.: ’were born’ · also ’came to be, got (on one’s way)’ (πρὸ ὁδοῦ ἐγένοντο ’got well on the road’)
ἐγχείῃ: ἐγχείη — spear; fem. dat. sg., epic by-form of ἔγχος, dat. of means: ’with the spear’
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐθέλητον: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. subj. 2 dual, after ὄφρα: ’you two wish’
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐκάλυψε: καλύπτω — cover, veil, enshroud; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’ · also dat. of possession: ’mine is, I have’ (ἐμοὶ δ’ ὄνομα ’my name is’)
ἐμῷ: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. dat. sg.
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’)
ἐπαΐξας: ἐπαΐσσω — dart upon, rush at; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
ἐπιστάμενοι: ἐπίσταμαι — know how to (+ inf.); pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’knowing how, skilled in’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’)
ἐρέω: ἐρέω — say, tell, declare; fut. 1 sg. (epic fut. of εἶπον, = Attic ἐρῶ); in tmesis with ἐκ, ἐξερέω ’speak out plainly’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐφ: ἐπί (elided ἐφ’ before a rough breathing) — on, upon, over; + dat. ’on’ · also + acc., ’to, towards’ · also in ὅσσον ἐφ’ …, ἐπί of unclear attachment: ’(lying) on, at’ · also + dat., ’against’ (Τρωσὶν ἐφ’ ἱπποδάμοισιν ’against the Trojans’)
ἐϋκνήμιδας: ἐϋκνήμις — well-greaved, with good greaves; masc. acc. pl., standing epithet of the Achaeans
ἐῢ: ἐΰς — good; neut. ἐῢ used as adv. ’well’ (= εὖ)
ἑὸν: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δῶμα: ’his own’
ἔασιν: εἰμί — be; epic pres. 3 pl. (= Attic εἰσίν): ’are’
ἔλαυνε: ἐλαύνω — drive; impf. 3 sg., without the lengthened augment (= Attic ἤλαυνε): ’drove’
ἔμεν: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic, shortened (= Attic εἶναι; cf. ἔμμεναι) · also μένω — stay, wait; impf. 3 sg., elided, augmented (ἔμεν’ = ἔμενε): ’he waited’
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔνθά: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’)
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’) · also ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’hither and thither, this way and that’
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔργον: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔσσεται: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 sg., epic doubled σ (= Attic ἔσται)
ἔστη: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg. intrans.: ’stood, took his stand’
ἔτ: ἔτι — still, any longer, further; adv., elided (ἔτ’); οὐδ’ ἔτ’ ’nor any more’
ἔχ: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (ἔχ’ = ἔχε): ’held, kept’
ἔχον: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶχον): ’held’
ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἕλοιτο: αἱρέω — take, choose; aor. opt. mid. 3 sg., potential with ἄν: ’would take, would choose’
ἕρκος: ἕρκος — fence, barrier, bulwark; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), correlative with ἠέ · also ’than’ after a comparative (γλυκίων … ἠὲ νέεσθαι ’sweeter than to go home’)
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’)
ἤριπε: ἐρείπω — throw down; in the intransitive aor. ἤριπον, fall headlong, crash down; aor. 3 sg.: ’fell headlong’
ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἥ τε κόμη ’and the hair’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. nom. sg., ’which’ (ἥ τε … πέληται ’which shall be’)
ἥρως: ἥρως — hero, man of standing; masc. nom. sg.
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’)
ἦλθον: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. 1 sg. (the same ending serves 3 pl.): ’I came’
ἧς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; fem. gen. sg.: ’whose’ (ἧς εἵνεκα ’for whose sake’) · also ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. gen. sg., agreeing with its noun (ἧς ἀλόχοιο ’his own wife’)
ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing, looking’
ἴδηαι: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. subj. mid. 2 sg., epic -ηαι (= Attic ἴδῃ), after ἵνα: ’you may see’
ἴθυνεν: ἰθύνω — make straight, guide, direct; aor. 3 sg.: ’guided’
ἵπποισιν: ἵππος — horse; masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic ἵπποις)
ὀΐω: ὀΐομαι — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg. (act. form ὀΐω, epic; = Attic οἴομαι): ’I think’
ὀξέϊ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic ὀξέϊ (= Attic ὀξεῖ)
ὀξὺ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; neut. acc. sg. · also used adverbially: ’sharply’ (ὀξὺ νόησε ’noticed sharply’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with βέλος: ’sharp (shaft)’
ὀρέξῃ: ὀρέγω — reach out, hold out, grant; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., in an indefinite relative clause: ’may grant’
ὀχέων: ὄχος — chariot, car (usually pl. ὄχεα); neut. gen. pl.
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’
ὄσσε: ὄσσε — the two eyes; neut. dual noun, no sg., epic (= Attic ὄμματα)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’
ὄχεσφιν: ὄχος — chariot, car (usually pl. ὄχεα); neut. dat./gen. pl., old case-suffix -φιν (= Attic ὄχοις, ὀχέων)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὅσσοι: ὅσος — as much/many as; epic ὅσσος, masc. nom. pl.: ’as many as’
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’)
ὑπόδρα: ὑπόδρα — with a scowl, ’from under the brows’ (ancient explanation; derivation uncertain); adv.
ὑφ: ὑπό (elided ὑφ’, before a rough breathing) — under; + gen. of agent: ’by, at the hands of’ · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑφ’ ἡμετέρῃσιν ’under our (hands)’)
ὠκέας: ὠκύς — swift; masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὠκεῖς)
ὠκὺ: ὠκύς — swift, quick; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’)
ὦσε: ὠθέω — push, thrust; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔωσε): ’thrust’
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
